// about: Reviewed values that scripts/checks/sinks.cjs lets into HTML without esc(): file -> { expression (whitespace collapsed) : reason }. A key written /like this/ is a regular expression. Review again whenever an expression here changes. A key starting with url: covers a value that starts a URL attribute (href=, src= on a frame, action=...).

Pages/Research/read.js.cls: linkBtn() parameter: a CSS class; every caller passes a literal or the default.
Pages/Research/read.js.icon: linkBtn() parameter: an SVG from the ICONS constant in assets/js/ui.js.
Pages/Research/read.js.elsewhere: linkBtn() results joined; linkBtn escapes the URL and the label.
Pages/Research/read.js.renderMarkdown(d.body): Markdown rendered by marked and sanitised by DOMPurify; maths by KaTeX renderToString (assets/js/markdown.js).

Pages/Research/research.js.cls: linkBtn() parameter: a CSS class; every caller passes a literal or the default.
Pages/Research/research.js.label: linkBtn() parameter: every caller passes a literal ("Read", "PDF", "DOI").
Pages/Research/research.js.icon: linkBtn() parameter: an SVG from the ICONS constant in assets/js/ui.js (the default).
Pages/Research/research.js.counts.get(t): A number: counts is a Map of topic -> item count built just above.

assets/js/collection-browser.js.o.render(it, state.layout): The render callback given to createBrowser(): renderPublication, renderArticle and renderFeedItem in Pages/Research/research.js, whose templates this check covers.
assets/js/collection-browser.js.state.page: A page number kept by the browser itself.
assets/js/collection-browser.js.o.latestCount: createBrowser() option: a number set in code.
assets/js/collection-browser.js.o.noun: createBrowser() option: a literal set in code ("publication", "article", "item").
assets/js/collection-browser.js.body: Markup built just above from checked templates (itemsHtml, archiveHtml) or esc().

assets/js/markdown.js.html: DOMPurify output plus KaTeX markup, parsed into an inert <template> to rewrite links and images.

assets/js/page-chrome.js.viewBox: svg() parameter: every call is in the ICONS constant, with literal arguments.
assets/js/page-chrome.js.extra: svg() parameter: every call is in the ICONS constant, with literal arguments.
assets/js/page-chrome.js.body: svg() parameter: every call is in the ICONS constant, with literal SVG markup.
assets/js/page-chrome.js.id: menuHTML() parameter: always `pc-menu-${i}` with a numeric index.
assets/js/page-chrome.js.position: One of "top", "bottom-left", "bottom-right": checked against that list just above.
assets/js/page-chrome.js.url:x.href: Menu and extra links from the page's own data-menus, data-extras and data-extra-href attributes on its page-chrome.js tag (authored in the page, installed by scripts/install-page-chrome.mjs); no record data.
assets/js/page-chrome.js.url:home: The page's own data-home attribute on its page-chrome.js tag, or the site's index.html.

control-panel/control-panel.js.title: heading() parameter: callers pass literals, constants (schema titles) or templates that this check covers.
control-panel/control-panel.js.sub: heading() and tile() parameter: callers pass literals, numbers or templates that this check covers.
control-panel/control-panel.js.actions: heading() parameter: literal button markup or templates that this check covers.
control-panel/control-panel.js.v: kv() value: every caller passes esc(...), ok(...) or literal markup.
control-panel/control-panel.js.href: tile() parameter: a literal in-page link such as "#publications".
control-panel/control-panel.js.label: tile() parameter: a literal.
control-panel/control-panel.js.value: tile() parameter: a count, "—", or timeAgo(...) text built from numbers.
control-panel/control-panel.js.schema.noun: From the SCHEMAS constant in this file.
control-panel/control-panel.js.name: renderCollection() parameter: a literal collection name from VIEWS.
control-panel/control-panel.js.f.key: A field key from the SCHEMAS constant in this file.
control-panel/control-panel.js.f.key.replace(/\\./g, \"-\"): A field key from the SCHEMAS constant in this file.
control-panel/control-panel.js.st.count: A number counted by syncArticles() in the browser.
control-panel/control-panel.js.key: num() parameter: every caller passes a literal setting name.
control-panel/control-panel.js.hint: num() parameter: every caller passes a literal.
control-panel/control-panel.js.s.count: A number counted by scanFeed() in the browser.
control-panel/control-panel.js.s.ms: A duration in milliseconds measured by scanFeed() in the browser.
control-panel/control-panel.js.url:href: tile() parameter: a literal in-page link such as "#publications".
